# World wide top seller VR game on PSVR2 is now on Horizon Store
Join our Discord : https://discord.com/invite/tshBHA4
[media]


- **Are you a Real VR gamer who is tired of copied, cheap games?**
- **Do you want challenges in real VR game?**

[media]

**Legendary Tales is all yours.**  Full-scale VR action RPG designed to deliver deep progression, physical combat, and true cooperative adventure. Built exclusively for immersive VR.

# Combat
Engage in intense physics-based combat where weapons have real weight, momentum, and collision. Swing swords, block attacks with shields.

# Skills
[media]
Progress your character through a deep skill tree system that allows you to define your own playstyle. Specialize as a warrior, rogue, mage, or create hybrid builds by freely combining skills. 


# Dungeon
[media]
# Discover item
[media]
Explore dungeons filled with enemies, traps, and powerful loot. Items are generated with random attributes, ensuring that every run feels fresh and rewarding. Discover rare gear and continuously chase better equipment.

# Crafting
[media]
Crafting plays a key role in your journey. Collect materials, craft weapons and improve your gear to prepare for tougher challenges ahead. 

# Multiplay
[media]
Legendary Tales can be played solo or in online co-op with friends. Team up to clear dungeons together, coordinate attacks in real time, share loot, and experience full physics-based combat in multiplayer. Cooperation, communication, and synergy turn each adventure into a memorable story.

Join our Discord : https://discord.com/invite/tshBHA4
